chapters.title: Find references
chapters.text: Sign in with your approved Google account. In Video Studio, search Douyin and select one to five references.

chapters.title: Add your footage
chapters.text: Upload your own vertical video, thirty seconds to three minutes long. Add a project name and script, and confirm your permission to edit the footage.

chapters.title: Set creator profile
chapters.text: Choose your topic and content language. Describe your audience, tone, and brand rules. Set your AI spending limit, then build the plan.

chapters.title: Review the plan
chapters.text: Read the reference analysis, then open Director Timeline. Check each suggestion against your footage. Approve useful changes, lock decisions, and save the plan.

chapters.title: Try an alternative
chapters.text: For a different approach, choose an unlocked decision and describe what should change. Review the AI alternative before replacing the decision. Your other choices stay intact.

chapters.title: Review the master
chapters.text: Render the approved plan and watch the master preview. Check the picture, speech, and subtitles yourself. Changes to the plan require a new render.

chapters.title: Export platform versions
chapters.text: Open Platform versions to create Douyin, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts exports. Review each version, then download the package. Lumen does not publish automatically.

chapters.title: 寻找参考
chapters.text: 使用已获授权的谷歌账号登录。在视频工作室搜索抖音，选择一到五个参考视频。参考素材只用于学习剪辑方法。

chapters.title: 上传自有素材
chapters.text: 上传三十秒到三分钟的自有竖屏视频。填写项目名称和脚本，并确认你拥有素材的编辑权限。

chapters.title: 设置创作者风格
chapters.text: 选择主题和内容语言，填写目标受众、表达风格与品牌要求。设置费用上限，然后点击分析并生成计划。

chapters.title: 审核剪辑计划
chapters.text: 先查看参考视频分析，再打开剪辑计划。对照自有素材逐条检查建议，批准有用的改动，锁定需要保留的决策，并保存计划。

chapters.title: 尝试备选方案
chapters.text: 想换一种剪法？选择未锁定的决策，说明修改方向，再生成备选方案。确认合适后替换，其他决策保持不变。

chapters.title: 检查主版本
chapters.text: 制作已批准的计划，然后观看主版本预览。亲自检查画面、语音和字幕。计划修改后，需要重新制作才能更新成片。

chapters.title: 导出平台版本
chapters.text: 打开平台版本，生成抖音、Instagram Reels 和 YouTube Shorts 三种导出版本。逐一审核后下载完整包。系统不会自动发布。
